standard-dialogue.npc: Hiya. Are you carrying anything valuable?
Um... It's a quiz. I'm asking everyone I meet if they're carrying anything valuable.

standard-dialogue.player: What would you do if I said I had loads of expensive items with me?

standard-dialogue.npc: Ooh, do you? It's been ages since anyone said they'd got anything worth stealing.
Um... Not that I'd dream of stealing anything!

standard-dialogue.player: Well, I'll say I'm not carrying anything valuable at all.
